meta.cell_definition: loss_16 = mean over the five copy calls of each call's 16-item mean; per-item columns = per-item mean over the five calls

conditions.real: condition (c): the unmodified data['lum'] -- the identity transform; diag1_eval_paths.py:191 unchanged
conditions.gray: condition (a): torch.full_like(data['lum'], 0.5) -- every input element 0.5, flyvis's own resting/background value (network.py:548-586, moving_bar.py:194)
conditions.zero: condition (b): torch.zeros_like(data['lum']) -- every input element 0.0, full-field black; NOT the resting state
conditions.shuffled: condition (d): data['lum'] with its frame axis (dim 1) permuted by numpy.random.default_rng([SHUFFLE_SEED, item_index]).permutation(n_frames), SHUFFLE_SEED=20260916; content and per-frame image statistics preserved, temporal ordering destroyed; the target is NOT permuted

meta.shuffle_derivation: numpy.random.default_rng([SHUFFLE_SEED, item_index]).permutation(n_frames), item_index = the dataloader enumeration index 0..15; identical in every process
